# rSignificativity

`rSignificativity` is an R package that implements the
$`\sigma`$-significativity for agreement values.

#### Help and support

## [![rSignificativity GitHub Pages](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20Pages-https://albertocasagrande.github.io/rSignificativity/-yellow.svg)](https://albertocasagrande.github.io/rSignificativity/)

### Installation

In order to install the development version of `rSignificativity`, you
need:

- [R and Rtools](https://cran.r-project.org)

- the R package [`devtools`](https://devtools.r-lib.org)

- the [GMP library](https://gmplib.org)

- [git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)

When the requirements have been satisfied, issue the R command:

``` r

pak::pak("albertocasagrande/rSignificativity")
```

## Citation

If you use **rSignificativity** in your research, please cite:

> A. Casagrande, F. Fabris, R. Girometti, and R. Pagliarini.
> **Significativity Indices for Agreement Values.** *Statistics and
> Computing*, 35(6):197, 2025.
> [doi:10.1007/s11222-025-10728-1](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11222-025-10728-1)

> A. Casagrande and R. Pagliarini. **A Marginal Significativity Index
> for Agreement Values.** In *2025 IEEE International Conference on
> Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM)*, pp. 5392–5399, 2025.
> [doi:10.1109/BIBM66473.2025.11356859](https://doi.org/10.1109/BIBM66473.2025.11356859)

# Package index

## Agreement Measures

- [`cohen_kappa()`](https://albertocasagrande.github.io/rSignificativity/reference/Cohen-single-quote-s-kappa.md)
  : Cohen's \\\kappa\\
- [`scott_pi()`](https://albertocasagrande.github.io/rSignificativity/reference/Scott-single-quote-s-pi.md)
  : Scott's \\\pi\\
- [`IA()`](https://albertocasagrande.github.io/rSignificativity/reference/Information-Agreement.md)
  : Information Agreement

## Sigma-Significativity

- [`marginal.significativity`](https://albertocasagrande.github.io/rSignificativity/reference/marginal.significativity.md)
  : Estimate the marginal \\\sigma\\-significativity of \\c\\
- [`significativity`](https://albertocasagrande.github.io/rSignificativity/reference/significativity.md)
  : The \\\sigma\\-significativity of \\c\\
- [`sample_prob_simplex`](https://albertocasagrande.github.io/rSignificativity/reference/sample_prob_simplex.md)
  : Uniformly sampling \\\Delta^{(k-1)}\\
- [`weak_composition_enum`](https://albertocasagrande.github.io/rSignificativity/reference/weak_composition_enum.md)
  : The lexicographic weak composition enumeration
